claim: Deno's --allow-all removes the meaningful permission boundary and production services should grant only required permissions.
WebSocket Origin checks do not replace authentication because non-browser clients can forge Origin.
OpenAI Skills use SKILL.md directories with optional references, scripts, and assets and require explicit local path discovery.
Too many skills can force shorter descriptions and reduce useful context, so discovery should be explicit and concise.
LSP standardizes editor-language-server communication over JSON-RPC and supports reuse of language servers across tools.
Deno provides built-in OpenTelemetry support for traces, metrics, and logs and supports custom instrumentation.
React Compiler supports incremental adoption and exposes diagnostics through eslint-plugin-react-hooks.
